The Thu/Fri clarification added a round trip when the human simply phoned and confirmed 15/02
reasoning: The tenant asked to move a routine inspection because of their dog. They wrote "Friday 15th February", but 15/02/2024 is a Thursday. The agent spotted the mismatch and texted the tenant to confirm Thu 15 or Fri 16. It said the 13/02 booking stands until a new date is confirmed, and it placed a hold with a follow-up date. It made no unsupported claims, committed no landlord money, and sent the message to the right party. The human's approach was to phone the tenant, accept 15/02 and rebook, so the agent's clarification was slower but safe and reasonable. The agent did not rebook, though it may have had no tool to do so. The agent also read an attachment that appears to postdate the decision point (a report dated 16 Feb). It treated that date as unverified, so the leakage was minor.
